description: This file defines the Cron	he CronExpression class, which provides parsing, validation, and scheduling functionalities for cron expressions. It includes methods to determine the next or previous run date, check if a cron is due, and manage cron parts. The class is central to handling cron schedule logic within the project.

classes.name: CronExpression
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing, validating, and calculating schedules for cron expressions. It supports generating next and previous run dates, checking if a schedule is due, and managing cron parts.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a CronExpression instance from a predefined string or custom cron string, optionally capturing alternative expressions like '@daily'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CronExpression with a given cron string and field factory.

methods.name: setExpression
methods.description: Sets or updates the cron expression parts after parsing the input string. Throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: setPart
methods.description: Sets a specific part of the cron expression after validating it.

methods.name: getNextRunDate
methods.description: Calculates and returns the next scheduled run date relative to the current or specified time.

methods.name: getPreviousRunDate
methods.description: Calculates and returns the previous scheduled run date relative to current or specified time.

methods.name: getMultipleRunDates
methods.description: Returns an array of upcoming or past run dates based on the parameters.

methods.name: getExpression
methods.description: Retrieves the full cron expression string or a specific part of it.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the full cron expression string when the object is treated as a string.

methods.name: isDue
methods.description: Checks whether the cron expression is due to run at the current or a specified time.

methods.name: getRunDate
methods.description: Internal method that calculates the next or previous run date based on the cron expression and current date.
